descripcion: Whole-body constants of the Earth, the Moon and Mars used by the analogue search (web/data/cuerpos). Each value carries a literal quotation checked against its source by scripts/verificar_citas.py. Values are in the unit of the source; the pipeline converts them.

constantes.texto: Earth volumetric mean radius
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Earth Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Moon volumetric mean radius
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Moon Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Mars volumetric mean radius
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Mars Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Earth mean surface gravity
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Earth Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Moon surface gravity
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Moon Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Mars mean surface gravity
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Mars Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Earth surface pressure
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Earth Fact Sheet)
constantes.cita: Surface pressure: 1014 mb Surface density: 1.217 kg/m3

constantes.texto: Moon surface pressure at night (daytime not given by the source)
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Moon Fact Sheet)
constantes.cita: Surface pressure (night): 3 x 10-15 bar (2 x 10-12 torr)
constantes.nota: the superscript of 10-15 is lost in the page text; the value is 3 × 10⁻¹⁵ bar

constantes.texto: Mars surface pressure at mean radius
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Mars Fact Sheet)
constantes.cita: Surface pressure: 6.36 mb at mean radius (variable from 4.0 to 8.7 mb depending on season)

constantes.texto: solar irradiance at the Moon (mean Earth-Sun distance)
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Moon Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: solar irradiance at Mars; equals 1361.0 × (149.598 / 227.956)², i.e. at the semimajor axis
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Mars Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Mars semimajor axis (Earth 149.598)
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Mars Fact Sheet)
constantes.nota: the superscript of 106 is lost in the page text; the unit is 10⁶ km

constantes.texto: Moon obliquity to its orbit about the Earth
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Moon Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: inclination of the Moon's orbit to the ecliptic; obliquity to the ecliptic = 6.68 − 5.145 = 1.535° (Cassini laws, as in pipeline/condiciones/astro.py)
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Moon Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Mars obliquity to its orbit
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Mars Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: eccentricity of the Earth's orbit, also the Moon's path around the Sun
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Earth Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: eccentricity of the orbit of Mars
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Mars Fact Sheet)

constantes.texto: Earth average temperature (plausibility check of the temperature layers)
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Earth Fact Sheet)
constantes.cita: Average temperature: 288 K (15 C) Diurnal temperature range: 283 K to 293 K (10 to 20 C)

constantes.texto: Moon diurnal temperature range at the equator (plausibility check of the Diviner layers)
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Moon Fact Sheet)
constantes.cita: Diurnal temperature range (equator): 95 K to 390 K

constantes.texto: Mars average temperature (plausibility check of the OpenMARS layers); the diurnal range is for the Viking 1 Lander site
constantes.organismo: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (NSSDCA, Mars Fact Sheet)
constantes.cita: Average temperature: ~214 K (-59 C) Diurnal temperature range: 184 K to 242 K (-89 to -31 C) (Viking 1 Lander site)

constantes.unidad: h of local time per bin
constantes.texto: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Products: bolometric brightness temperature per 0.5° cell and 0.25 h of local time (Williams et al. 2017, Icarus 283, 300-325)
constantes.organismo: UCLA / NASA PDS Geosciences Node (LRO Diviner)
constantes.cita: binned at 0.5 degree latitude and longitude and 0.25 hours of local time derived from a compilation of all nadir observations

constantes.texto: no-data value of the Diviner Global Cumulative Products
constantes.organismo: UCLA / NASA PDS Geosciences Node (LRO Diviner)
constantes.cita: Constant -9999 corresponds to bins that contained no observations.

constantes.texto: OpenMARS MY28-35 grid spacing; output every 2 Martian hours. Holmes, James; Streeter, Paul; Lewis, Stephen; Patel, Manish; Rajendran, Kylash (2023). OpenMARS continuous MY28-35 standard database. The Open University. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.21954/ou.rd.24573205.v3 (CC BY 4.0)
constantes.organismo: The Open University (OpenMARS reanalysis)
constantes.cita: grid spacing is 5˚ in both longitude and latitude

constantes.texto: OpenMARS surface temperature is a model field changed by assimilation, not a direct measurement
constantes.organismo: The Open University (OpenMARS reanalysis)
constantes.cita: Although none of the surface variables are directly assimilated in the reanalysis product, each one is altered indirectly as a result of the assimilation of temperature profiles and column dust optical depth.
